description: **Reproducible Code Execution:** All pipeline scripts execute with exit code 0 without unhandled exceptions.
**Statistical Assumption Integrity:** Schoenfeld residuals test confirms proportional hazards (p > 0.05).
**Ethical & Legal Anonymization:** 100% GDPR-compliant pseudonymization of cohort data (zero PII/PHI).
**Zero Missing Blood Imputation Gate:** Real laboratory blood draws validated on strict complete cases with zero synthetic imputation.
**First-Principles Derivation:** Tumor persistence modeled as a coupled reaction-diffusion PDE system with modified Bessel $K_0$ drug penetration.
**Analytical Lead Time Reproduction:** The continuum equations analytically reproduce the 5.46-month ctDNA lead time invariant.
**History-Dependent Immune Exhaustion:** Exhaustion modeled as an exponential functional of cumulative inflammatory exposure ($\int \Phi d\tau$).
**Carrying Capacity Saturation:** Logistic saturation limit ($1 - (N_S + N_R)/K$) enforced on cell populations.
**Discovery Multivariate Significance:** HTBI achieves HR > 2.0 and p < 0.05 controlling for pathologic stage, sex, smoking, and mutations (MSKCC N=604).
**Raw Laboratory Blood Chemistry Validation:** Validated on N=1,056 surgical oncology patients with raw pre-op CBC NLR and serum CRP/Albumin (p < 0.001, HR = 1.47).
**Proof by Contradiction (Reductio ad Absurdum):** Confirmed model falsification (failure) on negative control non-epithelial/liquid cohorts (LAML p=0.81, TGCT p=0.38, SARC p=0.42).
**Multi-Cohort Pan-Cancer Validation:** Evaluated across multiple independent patient cohorts ($N > 2,500$ real patients).
**Competing Risks Disease Specificity:** Aalen-Johansen CIF demonstrates cancer recurrence specificity (p=0.001) vs competing non-cancer mortality (p=0.72).
**Demographic Subgroup Homogeneity:** All Cox interaction term tests demonstrate statistical homogeneity ($p_{\text{int}} > 0.05$) across stage, smoking, sex, and EGFR.
**Decision Curve Analysis (DCA):** Model demonstrates positive Net Clinical Benefit over "treat-all" and "treat-none" across clinical decision thresholds.
**Empirical Calibration Curve:** Calibration curve evaluated at 24 months shows agreement between predicted and observed recurrence along the 45° line.
**Bootstrap Discrimination Gain:** 500-fold bootstrap confirms statistically significant incremental C-index ($\Delta C > 0, p < 0.05$).
**Bedside Parameter Feasibility:** Index computable from routine €5 complete blood count (NLR), standard biochemistry (CRP, albumin), BMI, and routine H&E histology.
**Raw Data Integrity (Table 1):** Demographic and clinical baseline counts computed directly from raw certified patient files without data fabrication.
**Complete Unified Manuscript Draft:** Full paper structured with Abstract, Intro, Methods, Results, Discussion, and Figures (`MANUSCRIPT_DRAFT.md`).
**REMARK 20-Point Audit Report:** Complete item-by-item compliance audit documented (`REMARK_COMPLIANCE_REPORT.md`).
**Interactive Decision Tool:** Standalone bedside clinical calculator with BMI and smoking implemented and functional (`app_bedside_calculator.py`).
**Complete High-Resolution Visual Suite:** Full 11-figure suite (Figures 1 through 11) generated and verified at 300 DPI.
